newsitem.title: USA: NYSE reviewing Westmoreland listing status.
newsitem.headline: NYSE reviewing Westmoreland listing status.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday it is reviewing Westmoreland Coal Co's eligibility for continued listing of its common stock and depository shares in light of the company's filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
The company filed for bankruptcy on December 23. The exchange halted trading of the company's stock on that day.
The exchange said the trading halt will remain in effect while it assess the effect of the bankruptcy filing.
Westmoreland said earlier this week that it was forced to file for bankruptcy because of a dispute over $160 million in retiree benefits.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Diane Jones, a company spokesman, said later Thursday that the exchange's action was "standard procedure" and was expected as a result of Westmoreland's bankruptcy filing.
"We will continue to work with the exchange," Jones said.
